description.value: Autostrada Oyster Bar and Grill is a seafood-forward restaurant perched in the small coastal community of Britannia Beach along the Sea-to-Sky corridor, operated by the same hospitality group behind a Vancouver Italian osteria. The menu leans into local Pacific ingredients — fresh-shucked oysters, BC albacore tuna, Salt Spring mussels, sockeye salmon — alongside pastas, burgers, and Italian-inspired starters. For a touring cyclist riding between Vancouver and Squamish, it is one of the few full-service dining options in this stretch of highway.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 46m; stands (2 spaces) at 47m; stands (2 spaces) at 65m; stands (2 spaces) at 67m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Autostrada Oyster Bar and Grill is an active, operating restaurant in Britannia Beach, with the phone number 604.894.0660 explicitly matching the OSM record and a dedicated Britannia Beach menu and reservation page. Online ordering is offered for the Britannia Beach location (footer link 'ONLINE ORDERS: BRITANNIA BEACH'), confirming takeout availability. The menu includes several clearly vegetarian dishes (Rigatoni Alla Norma, Forager mushroom burger, Bucatini Cacio e Pepe, Seasonal Greens Salad); no evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or connectivity amenities was found in the website content.
concerns: The website covers two distinct Autostrada locations (Britannia Beach Oyster Bar & Grill and Vancouver House Osteria); some subpages (e.g. /private-dining, /menus) appear to be primarily for the Vancouver location, so care should be taken not to attribute Vancouver-specific amenities or details to this listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant on the Sea-to-Sky corridor with a confirmed website and operating menus. A clear and useful stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian dishes: Rigatoni Alla Norma (eggplant, tomato, chili, garlic), Forager burger (wild mushrooms, caramelized onion, pecorino), Bucatini Cacio e Pepe (pepper, pecorino), and Seasonal Greens Salad
